paper_title: Laying the Foundation First Investigating the Generalization from   Atomic Skills to Complex Reasoning Tasks
caption: Error analysis on Vanilla model (left) and HCL model (right).
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates a breakdown of error types in a model, displaying a total of five categories. The categories are labeled "Atomic Skill Fail," "Correct," "Reason Error," "Question Misunderstood," and "2.0%". The slices are presented in shades of blue and gray; the largest slice, representing "Atomic Skill Fail," is colored a darker blue and occupies approximately 68% of the chart. Following in descending order are the slices for “Question Misunderstood” (approximately 14%), “Reason Error” (approximately 10%), "2.0%" (approximately 8%), and “Correct” (approximately 55%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. No slices are visually emphasized through explosion or other highlighting techniques, and the segments appear ordered by decreasing size. The chart does include a legend identifying the color associations with each category.
